summary: AgencyWebsites control manages agency websites data, allowing users to add, edit, and delete website entries associated with an agency. It includes validations and provides a user interface for managing website records.
purpose: To manage and display agency websites, allowing for edits and entries.

workflows.name: Manage Agency Websites
steps: Use cmdAdd to add new entry

business_rules: Websites can only be modified if ScreenIsEditable is true
validations: Ensure that the UserSession is active before data operations
Validation on website URL and name fields
conditions: Screen must be editable to modify data
system_behavior: Allows for interaction via form view
